_readme: Expected return dates for injured players, by season. ESPN's API publishes only a status (OUT, INJURY_RESERVE), never a return date, so this file is the source for what the news says. Give either return_date (YYYY-MM-DD, resolved to the player's first game on or after it) or return_week. Entries here always beat the default, which is the NFL's four-game injured-reserve minimum counted from the week the player was first seen on IR in data/snapshots/. Delete an entry once the player is back.

A.J. Brown.note: Out until November per Shaunak, 2026-09-25. First NE game in November is week 8 (@ MIA).
